summary: Retested the two reported bugs. (1) Invoices tab: renders fine as admin — no blank screen, no 'DialogFooter is not defined' page error; invoice-number click opens the detail dialog, DialogFooter buttons (Edit invoice / Download PDF / Print) are present and 'Edit invoice' opens the DocBuilder editor; Active/Paid/Voided tabs all render. (2) Accounting email with tokenized PDF link: created a $0.66 TEST invoice, recorded a full manual payment via POST /api/invoices/{iid}/manual-payment -> 200, status=paid, amount_paid=total, paid_at set; backend log confirms the auto accounting email POST to the provider returned 202 Accepted while the customer receipt to a fake address failed (422 undeliverable) and was swallowed without breaking the payment. GET /api/pub/invoice-pdf/{token} returns 200 application/pdf (%PDF magic, correct filename in Content-Disposition) with no auth, and 404 for an invalid token. Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt $2b$ hashes, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookies, allow_credentials with explicit origins, lockout after 5 failures (401x5 then 429), seed_admin updates existing admin password. 9/9 pytest cases passed; all TEST data cleaned up.

minor.issue: Provider 422 'Undeliverable recipient' is mapped to HTTP 502 'Failed to send email' in send_email(); the UI shows a generic server error instead of 'that recipient address is undeliverable'. Suggest mapping 422 -> 400 with provider message.

Tokens in db.invoice_pdf_tokens never expire and are never invalidated (no TTL index, no created_at check), so every emailed link grants permanent unauthenticated access to the invoice PDF. Also a new token is minted on every email send (receipt + accounting), so the collection grows unbounded. Add TTL index / expiry validation (same applies to po_pdf_tokens).
No single-invoice GET route exists (returns 405); clients must fetch the whole list to re-read one invoice.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key: Shipping' repeats on open — duplicate option/category key in the material or category select list

issues: Copy still says 'Sends invoice ... and the PDF for record keeping' — the email now contains a 'Download invoice PDF' link, not an attachment; update wording to avoid support confusion

design_issues.screen: Invoices > Edit Invoice (DocBuilder) and Record Payment dialogs
issues: Uses native browser date pickers (input type=date, mm/dd/yyyy) and native <select> elements instead of the shadcn Calendar/Select used elsewhere — inconsistent styling

action_items: Add expiry/TTL to invoice_pdf_tokens (and po_pdf_tokens) and validate age in public_invoice_pdf
Map email-provider 422 undeliverable-recipient to a 400 with a user-readable message instead of 502
Update Xero dialog description text: email now carries a secure download link, not an attachment
Fix duplicate React key 'Shipping' in DocBuilder select options
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3661 lines — split into routers (invoices, payments, email, pdf) for maintainability
_invoice_pdf_link mints an unlimited-lifetime public token per email; treat as a bearer credential with expiry and optionally single-use
manual-payment correctly wraps receipt email in try/except and _maybe_auto_accounting swallows exceptions (HTTPException included), so email failures cannot roll back a payment — verified in logs
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_QA customer + TEST_QA invoices (INV-29519, INV-29520) plus 2 manual payment records; DB verified clean afterwards. Invoice number counter advanced to ~INV-29520.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invoice create requires 'title' (422 without it). DELETE /api/invoices/{id} and /api/customers/{id} require a JSON body {"password": <admin password>}. There is no GET /api/invoices/{id} (405) — read via the list. Email provider rejects fake recipient domains with 422 (surfaced as 502); use delivered@resend.dev for real send tests. Tokens for /api/pub/invoice-pdf are only obtainable from db.invoice_pdf_tokens (not returned by any API). Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_invoice_pdf_link.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported bugs are fixed and verified: the blank Invoices tab was a missing DialogFooter import (now present at Invoices.jsx line 16, used at 340) and the page renders with zero page errors; the missing-PDF accounting email now sends a tokenized first-party download link served by GET /api/pub/invoice-pdf/{token}, which returns a valid PDF. Remaining risk is only the unbounded lifetime of those public tokens.
